pages.title: Sleep Bonus
pages.text: Sleeping while well-nourished grants a $(#52c252)Sleep Bonus$(). The more food groups you have filled, the stronger the bonus when you wake.

pages.title: How It Scales
pages.text:
Filling $(bold)all six groups$() to a healthy level before bed gives the maximum bonus — a burst of regeneration and a small boost to your nutrient levels on waking.

Neglecting your diet means waking up feeling no better than when you went to sleep.
